```java
/** 
 * Returns the ServiceReference for the protocol provider corresponding to the specified accountID or null if the accountID is unknown.
 * @param accountID the accountID of the protocol provider we'd like to get
 * @return a ServiceReference object to the protocol provider with thespecified account id and null if the account id is unknown to the provider factory.
 */
public ServiceReference getProviderForAccount(AccountID accountID){
  ServiceRegistration registration;
  try {
    synchronized (registeredAccounts) {
      registration=registeredAccounts.get(accountID);
    }
  } catch (NullPointerException e) {
    return null;
  }
  return (registration == null) ? null : registration.getReference();
}
```
